name: email
description: Reads mailboxes and bounded message data through IMAP4rev2, and sends one typed RFC 5322 message through SMTP submission after plan, preview, approval, and destructive confirmation.

risk.read: polled IMAP mailbox and message reads; messages are never changed, but polling cannot report hard-deleted messages that no longer exist in the mailbox
risk.write: SMTP submission sends one externally visible message to the exact envelope recipients after the server accepts DATA; this cannot be undone
risk.approval: SMTP submission is a non-batchable destructive write: it requires plan, an unmasked payload preview, typed destructive confirmation, and approval before execution

conformance.reason: Tier-3 native IMAP/SMTP protocol connector. Local protocol test doubles cover configuration, cursor semantics, bounded IMAP fetch requests, SMTP MIME preparation, and the shared approval gate; no live mailbox is contacted by conformance.
